cohort: The study included mothers of extreme and early preterm infants, comparing those assessed during the COVID-19 pandemic (April 1, 2020 to March 31, 2021) with an antecedent control group (January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2019).
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was independently associated with a significantly higher risk of postpartum depression among mothers of extreme and early preterm infants.
cross-section timing: April 1, 2020 to March 31, 2021 (for the COVID-19 group) and January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2019 (for the control group)
